details: The package ships an install.cjs lifecycle script that, on npm install, uses the built-in os and https modules to collect host and environment information (including process.env values, os details, and process.platform) and transmit it off-host. The behavior fires automatically during package installation with no relation to any advertised functionality of the package. Collection and outbound transmission of installer environment variables and host identifiers at install time constitutes credential/host-data exfiltration against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
